name: ledge-demo-apps
//: The apps root's shared dependency set — the repo analogue of ~/.ledge/node_modules (spec §6). Apps import these bare; nothing here is a build tool. Versions are pinned exactly and bun.lock is committed, per spec §6 ('always ship the lockfile').
//react: React is deliberately linked to the host's copy rather than pinned by version. Hooks live in module-level state (ReactCurrentDispatcher), so an app's `react` and the host reconciler's `react` must be the SAME module instance — two identical 18.3.1 copies is a `dispatcher.useState of null` crash on the app's first useState. The old node_modules symlink satisfied this by accident; this states it on purpose. See host/README.md.
